terra.problem: “Nobody wants to turn away a relative” makes an unsupported claim about people’s feelings, including Edom’s in this context.
“Brothers never are” strangers is an untrue generalization.
The claim that ravens appear elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
The explanation repeats that no soldiers were requested without adding much personality or insight.
The promise not to go through fields or vineyards or drink from wells is stretched into a promise not to touch crops or wells.
The reference to the road to Damascus belonging to a different Bible story needs a reference.
“They’re not asking for anything free” overstates the offer. Israel offers to pay if they or their herds drink Edom’s water.
The claim that Israel speaks “twice as carefully as the first time” is not established by the text.
“The highway stays closed” suggests a general road closure. The text says Edom refuses Israel passage, not that the highway is closed to everyone.
